sources.note: Proposes SPARC, a two-stage vision-language model pipeline that separates visual search from reasoning to make test-time scaling of visual grounding more modular and token-efficient.
sources.title: SPARC: Separating Perception And Reasoning Circuits for Test-time Scaling of VLMs

sources.note: OneTwoVLA is a single vision-language-action model that alternates between emitting explicit natural-language reasoning at selected moments of a robot manipulation task and emitting actions conditioned on the most recent reasoning at all other moments.
sources.title: OneTwoVLA: A Unified Vision-Language-Action Model with Adaptive Reasoning

result.definition: Visual grounding here means locating or connecting language to the relevant part of an image or scene as a distinct sub-task from downstream reasoning. SPARC separates visual search from reasoning into two pipeline stages to make test-time scaling more modular and token-efficient; OneTwoVLA instead alternates, within a single vision-language-action model, between emitting explicit natural-language reasoning at selected moments and emitting actions grounded in the most recent reasoning at all other moments.
